entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It has to be a fault. The heart rate monitor is just garbage. It's giving me readings that are completely wrong. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I'm just so disappointed.

I see. Inaccurate heart rate readings can definitely be frustrating. We do have a technical support team that's excellent at troubleshooting sensor calibration. Would you be open to me transferring you?
Oh, please no. I really don't have time for all that. I just want my money back. I was counting on this working, and I could really use the refund right now.
I understand you'd prefer a direct return. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I see here that your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 19 days ago. Let me check the return eligibility...

Alright, it looks like you're good to go. Our policy states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can process this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? Thank you so much, Charlie! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You'll see the full refund processed within 5-7 business days after we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
